descriptions.name: Deal name/title text. Free text column (text). Populated in 346 of 346 rows (100%). Examples: Naruto, Sasuke, Sasuke.
descriptions.Owner code: The employee code of the person owning this deal. Code identifying the deal owner. Category column (text). Populated in 329 of 346 rows (95%). Allowed values: OWNER_001, OWNER_002, OWNER_003, OWNER_004, OWNER_005, OWNER_006, OWNER_007.
descriptions.Client Code: Code identifying the client company. Identifier column (text). Populated in 344 of 346 rows (99%). 199 distinct values, e.g. COMPANY089, COMPANY091, COMPANY124.
descriptions.Deal Status: The final status of the deal (e.g. Won, Lost). Overall deal status (Open, Won, Dead, etc.). Category column (text). Populated in 345 of 346 rows (100%). Allowed values: Open, On Hold, Deal Status, Dead, Won.
descriptions.Close Date (A): The ACTUAL Close Date of the deal (when it was won/lost). Actual close date of the deal. Date column (date). Populated in 26 of 346 rows (8%). Mostly empty (92% missing) — treat any figure derived from it as covering a minority of records.
descriptions.Closure Probability: The percentage likelihood of closing this deal. Qualitative likelihood of closing (High/Medium/Low). Category column (text). Populated in 88 of 346 rows (25%). Allowed values: High, Medium, Low, Closure Probability. Mostly empty (75% missing) — treat any figure derived from it as covering a minority of records.
descriptions.Masked Deal value: The financial value/revenue of the deal. Monetary value of the deal. Monetary amount column (number). 165 of 346 rows carry a non-zero figure; 0 are zero, 181 blank. Mostly empty (52% missing) — treat any figure derived from it as covering a minority of records.
descriptions.Tentative Close Date: The TENTATIVE Close Date (projected by sales, not final). Expected close date of the deal. Date column (date). Populated in 270 of 346 rows (78%).
descriptions.Deal Stage: Sales pipeline stage of the deal. Category column (text). Populated in 346 of 346 rows (100%). 17 distinct values, e.g. B. Sales Qualified Leads, E. Proposal/Commercials Sent, D. Feasibility.
descriptions.Product deal: Product/service mix in the deal. Category column (text). Populated in 176 of 346 rows (51%). Allowed values: Service + Spectra, Pure Service, Spectra + DMO, Hardware, Dock + DMO + Spectra + Service, Dock + Spectra + Service, Dock + DMO + Spectra, Dock + DMO, Spectra Deal, Product deal.
descriptions.Sector/service: The business sector or service category. Industry sector or service line of the deal. Category column (text). Populated in 338 of 346 rows (98%). Allowed values: Mining, Powerline, Tender, Renewables, DSP, Railways, Construction, Security and Surveillance, Sector/service, Others, Aviation, Manufacturing.
descriptions.Created Date: Date the deal was created. Date column (date). Populated in 343 of 346 rows (99%).
